mutations.label: ADR-077 T1: a run holds a lease while it runs
mutations.from:
publish(file, lease, rename)
      return { file, lease, made }
mutations.only: ^a run holds a lease while it runs and releases it at its end$

mutations.label: ADR-077 T1: a dead lease is removed
mutations.only: ^a dead lease is removed, and an unreadable one is named as unknown and kept$

mutations.label: ADR-077 T1: a waiter is admitted in ticket order
mutations.only: ^a waiter never starts ahead of an earlier waiter's ticket$

mutations.label: ADR-077 T2: a killed parent's lease stays while its child works
mutations.from:
const answers = [lease.pid, lease.child].filter(pid => pid !== undefined).map(alive)
  if (lease.group !== undefined) answers.push(groupAlive(lease.group, platform))
mutations.only: ^a killed campaign parent's lease stays live while its child works$

mutations.label: Codex 3.3.0 #1: a symlinked lease directory is not used
mutations.only: ^a lease directory that is a symlink is not used, and nothing is written through it$

mutations.label: Codex 3.3.0 #2: deciding and marking running are one admission
mutations.from:
const lock = holdAdmission(dir)
  if (!lock) return false
mutations.only: ^two waiters cannot both be admitted when one publishes while the other decides$

mutations.label: Codex 3.3.0 #8: a bound that overflows is the default
mutations.only: ^a wait bound too large to be a number of milliseconds is the default$

mutations.label: §332: a lease renames without the retry
mutations.only: ^a campaign's owner record and a lease are both written through the retry$
